messages:
Priya: Heads up — I need to sign off in ~25m. Quick handoff notes for the evening shift:

Priya: Current pool status: GPU-pool-eu-1 at ~65% util, GPU-pool-us-west at ~58%. Burst slots available: eu=2, us-west=3.

Priya: Known risk: expecting a customer batch spike from cust-batch-42 around 17:30 UTC (they hit this pattern last week). If queue depth > 120 and p95 latency > 300ms, please enable temporary burst (policy: burst_multiplier=1.5) and monitor costs.

Priya: Quick config snippet I applied to canary policy (so you know what to revert if needed):
```
canary: {
  burst_multiplier: 1.5,
  max_burst_slots: 4,
  scale_cooldown_s: 120
}
```

oncall-bot: autoscale-event: +2 GPUs to GPU-pool-eu-1 at 16:48 UTC (trigger: queue_length>80).

Javier: I can take 17:00–19:30 UTC. I'll watch queues & alerts. Ping me if you need me to flip the canary back.

Naomi: I'll be on standby for customer comms — if cust-batch-42 errors spike I'll open a ticket and DM support. Also muting their noisy low-priority alert channel to reduce chatter.

Priya: Thanks. Small troubleshooting tip: if you see sustained KR eviction spikes, try increasing kv-cache shard limit to 6 for the canary model (that helped earlier).

Javier: Noted. Where's the dashboard link?

Priya: https://console.redwood.internal/d/pools/eu-1 and the quota check endpoint: `GET /internal/quotas/gpu-pool-eu-1` — returns JSON with headroom and reserved slots.

Javier: Saw a couple retries from cust-42 at 16:52 (5xx on worker). Restarted their ephemeral worker set — errors stopped briefly. Keeping an eye.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary-policy v1.3 rolled at 16:50 by Priya.

Naomi: If we need to scale more than burst allows, I can coordinate with infra to temporarily reassign a slot from low-priority pool. Want me to do that if latency > 500ms for >10m?

Javier: Yeah please — escalate then. I'll also open a short post-run log in the oncall folder.

Priya: Perfect. I left a short checklist in the runbook (link pinned in #eng-oncall). Logging out now — Javier / Naomi, you're up. :thumbsup:

Javier: Taking over. ping me here for anything.

Naomi: On it, thanks Priya.

oncall-bot: reminder: next handoff window scheduled 19:30 UTC.
